title: Maikura Mining Tools
description: Specialized mining and exploration tools for Minecraft.
body:
# Maikura Mining Tools

Specialized mining and exploration tools designed for late-game progression.

## Included Tools

### Deep Abyss Pickaxe

A powerful pickaxe capable of breaking bedrock and efficiently mining obsidian-based blocks.

### Ancient Debris Detector Pickaxe

Detect nearby Ancient Debris hidden within the Nether.

### Ore Detector Pickaxe

Search for nearby ore deposits while mining underground.

### End Explorer Pickaxe

Locate the nearest End City or End Gateway from anywhere in the End.

### Giant Tree Felling Axe

Fell entire trees with a single tool and simplify large-scale wood collection.

---

## Features

* Bedrock breaking support
* Ancient Debris detection
* Ore detection
* End City detection
* End Gateway detection
* Giant tree felling
* Mod Menu configuration support
* Individual tool enable/disable settings
* Adjustable detection ranges
* Adjustable durability costs

---

## Configuration

Every tool can be individually enabled, disabled, and adjusted through Mod Menu.

Server owners and modpack creators can customize the balance to fit their gameplay.

---

## Included Tools

* Deep Abyss Pickaxe
* Ancient Debris Detector Pickaxe
* Ore Detector Pickaxe
* End Explorer Pickaxe
* Giant Tree Felling Axe
